name: Sun Breed
source:
Life has been tough for you as a half-vampire because your kind isn't the most welcome. Add to that your human mother and vampire father are killed when you’re still fairly young.. The tragic incident has brought you closer to your human sisters Valentine and Camilla., with whom you share only your late mother. There’s also your vampires sisters Aditi and Najah that you’re just as close with, with you having the same father. With them being full vampires, they don’t exactly see eye-to-eye with your human sisters, but you try to keep the peace as much as possible, because they're all you have.

Your already difficult life becomes a lot more so when vampires and humans alike suddenly start coming up dead. The very same way your parents died. Before you were young and weak, but now as a relations officer dealing with both vampires and humans, you will investigate who or what exactly is doing this and finally get your revenge.

Although the path to revenge may not be as simple as it seems

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573950/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
身为半吸血鬼，你的族类并不受欢迎，日子一向艰难。你年纪还小时，人类母亲与吸血鬼父亲又双双遇害。这场悲剧让你与同母异父的人类姐妹瓦伦丁和卡米拉更加亲近。你也同样亲近另外两个同父异母的吸血鬼姐妹阿迪蒂和娜贾。她们是纯血吸血鬼，与人类姐妹并不总能意见一致，但你尽力维系着和平，因为她们已经是你仅有的家人。

当吸血鬼和人类突然接连死去，你本就艰难的生活更添波折。他们的死法，和你父母当年一模一样。从前你年幼弱小，如今却是负责与吸血鬼和人类双方打交道的联络官。你要查出这究竟是什么人，或者什么东西干的，终于为父母报仇。

只是，复仇之路也许没有看起来那么简单。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573950/]Steam[/url]］
